title: Billerica corrections officer indicted in alleged assault on inmate
author: Morgan Rousseau
bullets: Local News Prosecutors allege Alexander Tine pushed a prisoner's foot through a cell opening and repeatedly struck the door while the person’s arm was caught inside.
A corrections officer at a Billerica jail has been indicted in connection with an alleged assault on an incarcerated person, Middlesex District Attorney Marian Ryan’s office announced.

Alexander Tine was arraigned in Middlesex Superior Court on Thursday after a Middlesex County grand jury indicted him on two counts of assault and battery and one count of filing a false report, according to the district attorney’s office.
